blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Spin in clinical trials includes reporting practices that distort the presentation of results. This is particularly critical in medicine, where spin is present in more than 50% of randomized controlled trials that fail to reach statistical significance. The comparison of primary and reported outcomes is crucial for detecting several types of spin, including outcome switching. We used 300 pairs of outcomes labeled with semantic similarity to develop a system for automatic detection of outcome switching. We evaluated baseline text similarity models and open-source LLMs using generated similarity scores and the Youden index to determine the classification threshold. The proposed approach involves prompt engineering, classification based on token probabilities, and majority voting for the final decision. The results on the test set of 2,496 examples with an F1 score of 0.78 and an accuracy of 0.90 outperform baseline text similarity models but trail behind fine-tuned versions of BERT. We used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified instances and manually assessed their quality.
blocks.zh: 在临床试验中自转包括扭曲结果列报的报告做法。 这一点在医学中特别重要,因为50%以上的随机控制试验没有达到统计意义。 对主要结果和报告结果进行比较对于发现几种类型的旋转,包括结果转换至关重要。 我们用300对标注语义相似的结果来开发一个自动检测结果切换的系统. 我们利用生成的相似性分数和Youden指数评估了基线文本相似性模型和开源LLMs,以确定分类阈值。 拟议办法涉及迅速工程、基于象征性概率的分类以及对最后决定的多数表决。 测试组的2,496例,F1得分0.78,精度0.90超过基线文本相似性模型,但落后于BERT的微调版本. 我们使用LLMS来为分类事件生成自然语言解释,并人工评估其质量.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: The phenomenon of spin covers several reporting practices that present study results in a distorted way, usually to the benefit of the authors. It is a long-known problem, especially in randomized controlled trials (RCTs), where reporting rules are clearly defined, yet incorrect reporting still occurs. This leads to redundant or misdirected follow-up research Glasziou et al., 2014 . Several tools exist to help authors and readers automatically detect this kind of incorrect reporting.
blocks.zh: 旋转现象包括若干报告做法,这些做法以扭曲的方式产生研究结果,通常有利于作者。 这是一个众所周知的问题,特别是在随机控制的审判中,报告规则已明确界定,但报告仍然不正确。 这导致了"Glasziou等"(Glasziou等,2014年)的重复或被误导的后续研究. 有几个工具可以帮助作者和读者自动发现这种不正确的报道.

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have recently become capable of solving many natural language processing (NLP) tasks without task-specific training Naveed et al., 2025 . Existing spin detection tools rely on dedicated models trained on expensive, manually labeled data, and to our knowledge none of them make use of LLMs. We investigate whether LLMs can be used to classify pairs of primary and reported clinical trial outcomes as similar or different. This is a core subtask needed for detecting a type of spin called outcome switching - compromised reporting of primary and secondary outcomes in the results.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)最近开始有能力解决许多自然语言处理(NLP)任务,而不进行具体任务培训 Naveed等,2025. 现有的自旋检测工具依赖于经过昂贵的手工标记数据培训的专用模型,据我们所知,这些模型都没有使用LLM. 我们调查LLMS是否可用于将一对初级和已报告的临床试验结果分类为相类似或相异. 这是一项必要的核心子任务,用于检测一种称为结果转换的自旋 -- -- 对结果中的初级和次级结果的报告受到影响。

blocks.en: We addressed the following research questions in the context of detecting outcome switching in RCT reports: (1) How successful are LLMs, without additional training, at classifying pairs of clinical trial outcomes as similar or different? (2) How do the results and behavior of different LLMs differ with respect to generality and comprehension ability? (3) Can LLMs generate meaningful, human-readable explanations for the already classified examples? We report the work in six sections. Section 2 outlines the related work. Section 3 presents the methodology and Section 4 the results. The discussion is contained in Section 5, and the conclusions follow in Section 6. 1 1 1 This research was conducted in academic year 2024/25 as part of a bachelor’s thesis.
blocks.zh: 我们在研究中心报告发现结果转换时讨论了下列研究问题: (1) 在没有额外培训的情况下将临床试验结果的对子归类为类似或不同的有限责任公司取得了多大的成功? (2) 不同法学硕士的结果和行为在一般性和理解能力方面有何不同? (3) LLMS能否为已经分类的例子产生有意义的、人能读取的解释? 我们分六节报告工作。 第二节概述了相关工作。 第3节介绍了方法,第4节介绍了结果。 讨论载于第5节,结论载于第6节,第1节,第1节,这一研究作为学士论文的一部分,在2024/25学年进行。

blocks.zh: 在没有额外培训的情况下将临床试验结果的对等分类为类似或不同方面,法学硕士有多成功?

blocks.en: How do the results and behavior of different LLMs differ with respect to generality and comprehension ability?
blocks.zh: 不同法学硕士的结果和行为在一般性和理解能力方面有何不同?

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Spin is defined as the distorted presentation of study results, which misleads readers about how effective a treatment actually is Chiu et al., 2017 . It may be intentional or simply a consequence of negligence Boutron and Ravaud, 2018 . In RCTs, the result of interest is referred to as the outcome of the trial. Since readers often judge a study by its abstract alone, it is especially prone to spin: manual audits report spin in 47–71% of clinical trial abstracts that fail to confirm their hypothesis, depending on the biomedical field Khan et al., 2019 ; Lockyer et al., 2013 ; Vera-Badillo et al., 2016 ; Wang et al., 2021 .
blocks.zh: Spin被定义为对研究成果的扭曲表述,这误导了读者对于治疗实际效果的Chiu等人,2017. Boutron和Ravaud,2018年。 在RCTs中,利息的结果被指为审判的结果. 由于读者往往仅凭抽象地判断某项研究,它尤其容易旋转:人工审计报告在47-71%的临床试验摘要中旋转而未能证实他们的假设,这取决于生物医学领域Khan等,2019年;Lockyer等,2013年;Vera-Badillo等,2016年;Wang等,2021年.

blocks.en: According to Yavchitz et al. (2016) , spin falls into three main groups:
blocks.zh: 根据Yavchitz等人(2016年),旋转分为三大类:

blocks.en: • Misleading reporting of results: inconsistent or incomplete reporting, such as omitting an outcome that did not confirm the hypothesis, adding a new outcome that does, or changing the order of primary and secondary outcomes. • Inappropriate interpretation of results: incorrect conclusions drawn from even correctly reported data, such as unjustified causal language or claims not based on the actual statistical results. • Inappropriate extrapolation of results: unjustified generalization, such as extending treatment effects to a different population.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 错误地报告结果:报告不一致或不完整,例如,略去一个没有证实假设的结果,增加一个确实如此的新结果,或改变初级和次级结果的顺序。 • 对结果的解释不当:从即使正确报告的数据中得出错误的结论,如不合理的因果语言或没有根据实际统计结果提出的索赔。 • 对结果的推断不当:不合理的概括,例如将治疗效果扩大到不同的人群。

blocks.en: Misleading reporting of results: inconsistent or incomplete reporting, such as omitting an outcome that did not confirm the hypothesis, adding a new outcome that does, or changing the order of primary and secondary outcomes.
blocks.zh: 错误地报告结果:报告不一致或不完整,例如,略去一个没有证实假设的结果,增加一个确实如此的新结果,或改变初级和次级结果的顺序。

blocks.en: Inappropriate interpretation of results: incorrect conclusions drawn from even correctly reported data, such as unjustified causal language or claims not based on the actual statistical results.
blocks.zh: 对结果的解释不当:从甚至正确报告的数据中得出不正确的结论,例如不合理的因果语言或没有根据实际统计结果提出的索赔。

blocks.en: Inappropriate extrapolation of results: unjustified generalization, such as extending treatment effects to a different population.
blocks.zh: 对结果的推断不当:不合理的概括,例如将治疗效果扩大到不同的人群.

blocks.en: Automatic tools for detecting spin can benefit both authors in writing, as well as readers and reviewers in critically evaluating articles. ExaCT (2010) uses statistical models and regular expressions to extract key trial information, such as sample size, from RCT abstracts into a table Kiritchenko et al., 2010 . RobotReviewer (2015) uses a machine learning model trained on 12,800 labeled clinical trial reports to assess their level of bias Marshall et al., 2016 . DeSpin (2020) uses fine-tuned pre-trained language models (PLMs) to detect several types of spin in RCTs, by breaking the task down into extraction, detection, and classification sub-tasks Koroleva et al., 2020 . One such example is comparing the primary and reported outcomes , needed to detect inconsistent reporting, specifically outcome switching. This is also the task addressed in this paper, using large language models, presuming that outcomes were already extracted.
blocks.zh: 用于检测自旋的自动工具可以使书面作者以及批评性评价文章的读者和审查者都受益. ExACT(2010)使用统计模型和正则表达法从RCT摘要中取出关键试验信息,如样本大小,入表Kiritchenko等,2010. RobotReviewer (2015)使用12,800个被标注临床试验报告所训练的机器学习模型来评估其偏差程度 Marshall等,2016. DeSpin (2020)使用微调预训语言模型(PLM)来检测RCTs中的几类自旋,将任务分解为提取,检测,并分类分出分任务 Koroleva等,2020. 其中一个例子是比较主要结果和报告结果,以发现报告不一致,特别是结果转换。 这也是本文件所处理的任务,它使用大语言模型,假定已经提取了结果。

blocks.en: 3. Methodology
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1. Dataset
blocks.zh: 3.1. 数据集

blocks.en: Comparing primary and reported outcomes can be framed as a directed semantic similarity task in the context of biomedicine. This is crucial for automatically checking whether the stated objectives of a clinical trial are correctly reported and met. Koroleva et al. (2019) built a dataset of such outcome pairs from 3,938 RCT articles available on PubMed Central 2 2 2 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3234827 . One human annotator, after consulting domain experts, labeled 3,043 pairs as similar (label 1) or different (label 0) . We then deduplicated the pairs, leaving 2,796. This dataset was imbalanced, with 21.8% of pairs labeled as similar and 78.2% as different, as a consequence of the collection methodology. An example pair labeled as similar is the primary outcome log HbA1c , reported as glycaemic control . This is a broader term, and recognizing it as a match requires domain knowledge of (blood sugar) measurements. An example of a negative pair is the primary outcome blood pressure , reported as systolic BP , which is a more specific term.
blocks.zh: 比较主要结果和所报告的结果可以被描述为生物医学方面的直接语义相似性任务。 这对于自动检查临床试验的既定目标是否得到正确报告和达到至关重要。 Koroleva等人(2019年)在PubMed Central 2 2 2 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.3234827上提供了3,938 RCT文章的此类结果对数据集. 。 。 。 。 一名人类注释员在咨询了域名专家后,将3,043对标签为相近(标签1)或相异(标签0). 然后我们拆了两对,留下了2796个 这一数据集存在不平衡,21.8%的对子被标为相似,78.2%被标为不同,这是收集方法的结果. 标有类似标签的一对实例是主要结果日志HbA1c,报告为甘油控制. 这是一个更广泛的术语,承认它是匹配的,需要域知识(血糖)测量. 一个负对的例子就是主要结果血压,报告为Systolic BP,这是一个更具体的术语.

blocks.en: From the deduplicated pairs, we randomly sampled 300 for our own experiments: 100 for model tuning and 200 for validation. The remaining 2,496 pairs were used for the final testing. The tuning, validation and test sets contained 31.0%, 21.5% and 21.4% similar pairs respectively, compared to 21.8% overall. Due to unstratified sampling, the tuning set is biased toward similar pairs, relative to the whole deduplicated dataset.
blocks.zh: 从被分解的对子中,我们随机抽取了300个样本,用于自己的实验:100个用于模型调制,200个用于验证. 其余2,496对用于最终测试. 调制、验证和测试设备的配对率分别为31.0%、21.5%和21.4%,而总体比例为21.8%。 由于未分层取样,相较于整个被破碎的数据集,调制集偏重于相近对.

blocks.en: 3.2. Metrics

When comparing texts, most models produce a continuous similarity score on the interval [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] rather than a direct label, so a threshold is needed to turn this score into a binary decision. We used the Youden index to determine this threshold automatically, rather than setting it manually, which would be time-consuming and prone to bias Kim et al., 2018 . blocks.en: We reported classification accuracy, positive-class precision, recall, and F 1 F_{1} score as evaluation metrics, with F 1 F_{1} as the main one.

blocks.en: 3.3. Baseline Models
blocks.zh: 3.3. 基线模式

blocks.en: Koroleva et al. (2019) divided baseline text similarity models into the following groups, each representing sentences differently:
blocks.zh: Koroleva等人(2019年)将基线文本相似性模型分为以下几组,每组代表不同句子:

blocks.en: (1) String measures treat sentences as sequences of characters. We evaluated the Levenshtein distance and sequence similarity based on the Ratcliff-Obershelp distance. (2) Lexical measures operate on words or word parts. We evaluated lemma similarity and stem similarity. (3) Vector-based measures embed text into a vector space and compare vectors using distances such as cosine distance. We evaluated spaCy and Word2Vec embeddings. (4) Ontology-based measures represent language as a hierarchy of concepts and compute distances between them. We evaluated path distance, Leacock-Chodorow similarity, and Wu-Palmer similarity. (5) Deep learning models use contextual representations from large pre-trained encoders. We evaluated SciBERT and BioBERT as sentence embedding models, as well as the all-MiniLM-L12 sentence transformer 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L12-v2 .
blocks.zh: (1)字符串措施将句子作为字符序列. 我们根据拉特克利夫-奥伯斯菲尔德的距离 评估了莱文斯廷的距离和序列相似性 (2) 语法措施适用于词或词部分。 我们评价了丽玛的相似性 并阻止了相似性 (3)以矢量为基础的测量法将文本嵌入矢量空间,并使用相差如余弦相差来比较矢量. 我们评估了spanCy和Word2Vec嵌入. (4)基于肿瘤的计量法代表了语言作为概念的分级并计算它们之间的距离. 我们评估了路径距离, 利科克-乔多罗相似, 和吴-帕尔默相似。 (5)深层学习模型使用来自大型预训编码器的背景表现. 我们评价了SciBERT和BioBERT作为句子嵌入模型,以及全MiniLM-L12句子变换器 3 3 3 https://huggingface.co/pentence-transfers/all-MiniLM-L12-v2 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.4. Large Language Models
blocks.zh: 3.4. 大语文模式

blocks.en: To make our approach widely accessible, we selected open-source LLMs available on HuggingFace and ran them locally with their transformers library. Local inference avoids API costs and latency, while keeping data private in the sensitive medical domain. We ran experiments on a single NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM, which limited the model size to up to 8B parameters . We considered only instruction fine-tuned variants, as these follow user prompts rather than simply continuing text.
blocks.zh: 为了普及我们的方法,我们选择了HuggingFace上的开源LLM,并用他们的变压器库在当地运行. 本地推论避免了API的成本和耐久性,同时将数据保密于敏感的医学领域. 我们用16GB的VRAM对单个NVIDIA Quadro RTX 5000 GPU进行了实验,将模型尺寸限制在8B参数以内. 我们考虑的只是指令的微调变体,因为这些变体遵循用户的提示,而不只是继续文本。

blocks.en: We evaluated four LLMs with different characteristics:
blocks.zh: 我们评价了四个具有不同特点的有限责任公司:

blocks.en: • OLMo-7B-Instruct 4 4 4 https://huggingface.co/allenai/OLMo-7B-Instruct-hf was chosen for its complete transparency. The architecture, training data, and procedure are publicly documented and replicable. The model was trained on 2.46T tokens, with over 2% of scientific articles. • Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 5 5 5 https://huggingface.co/mistralai/Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 is a general-purpose LLM with slightly better benchmark results than OLMo. • BioMistral-7B-DARE 6 6 6 https://huggingface.co/BioMistral/BioMistral-7B-DARE is a variant of Mistral further trained on PubMed Central literature, giving it stronger biomedical terminology knowledge at the cost of generality. • Llama-3-8B-Instruct 7 7 7 https://huggingface.co/meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct was reportedly trained on 15T tokens and achieves the best reasoning scores.

blocks.en: We first tested LLMs as binary similarity classifiers by inserting a pair of outcomes into a prompt template and extracting a Yes or No prediction from the generated text:
blocks.zh: 我们首先测试LLMS作为二进制相似性分类器,将一对结果插入到一个即时模板,并从生成的文本中提取出一个是或否的预测:

blocks.en: Algorithm 1 Classification via LLM token probabilities
blocks.zh: 算法 1 通过 LLM 符号概率分类

blocks.en: This text-based approach has several limitations related to LLM answer format and extraction. We therefore adopted a probability-based approach , outlined in Algorithm 1 Yu et al., 2024 . It uses probabilities of the first generated token to obtain a similarity score between 0 and 1, similar to how the MMLU benchmark Hendrycks et al., 2020 evaluates multiple-choice answers. In our case, these are the tokens for Yes and No .
blocks.zh: 这种以文字为基础的方法有一些与LLM解答格式和提取有关的局限性. 因此,我们采取了一种基于概率的办法,见Agorithm 1 Yu等,2024年。 它使用第一个生成的令牌的概率来得到0到1之间的相近分数,类似于MMLU基准Hendrycks等2020年评价多选择答案的方式. 就我们而言,这些是"是"和"不是"的象征。

blocks.en: We used the LangChain library to define multiple prompt templates Chen et al., 2025 , varying in complexity from simple similarity questions to outcome switching definitions and few-shot examples. All tested prompts are available in our GitHub repository 8 8 8 https://github.com/ta5946/Spin/blob/main/src/models/prompt_templates.py and can be modified as needed. Experiments used deterministic decoding with temperature set to 0. We measured AUC on the 200 instance validation set to compare model quality across prompts, before setting the classification threshold, as shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh: 我们用LangChain 库来定义多个快速模板 Chen等,2025年,从简单的相似性问题到结果切换定义和少有镜头的例子,复杂性不一. 所有经过测试的提示可在我们的GitHub寄存器8 8 https://github.com/ta5946/Spin/blob/main/src/models/prompt_templates.py中找到,并可根据需要修改. 实验采用定温解码法,将温度设定为0. 我们在确定分类阈值之前,用200个实例验证组对AUC进行了测量,以比较各提示的模型质量,如图1所示。

AUC scores across different LLMs and prompt complexity levels. Prompt names for each illustrative complexity level are provided in Table~\ref{tab:prompt_names}.

blocks.en: The prompt with complexity 3, which defines the role of a clinical trial reviewer and the concept of primary and reported outcomes, was chosen as the starting point for further experiments. This prompt was near the middle of the AUC curve, which resembled an inverted U shape. Its average AUC score was comparable to the other prompts, but its range across models was the smallest. This indicates little bias, meaning none of them considerably over- or underperformed.
blocks.zh: 具有复杂性的即时3,它界定了临床试验审查员的作用以及初级和报告结果的概念,被选为进一步试验的起点。 这个提示符靠近AUC曲线中段,它类似于倒转的U形状. 其平均AUC分数与其他快取相上下相上下下,但其跨模型的射程最小. 这表明没有多少偏见,也就是说,没有一个偏见表现得相当好或不足。

blocks.en: We then applied the Youden index to the 100-instance training set to determine the classification threshold and used it to obtain binary predictions on the 200-instance validation set. We manually inspected instances misclassified by the OLMo model and identified three recurring error types: (a) insufficient domain terminology and acronym knowledge (for example, HbA1c ), (b) poor comprehension of longer sentences, and (c) acceptance of partially reported outcomes . We addressed (c) by iteratively adding clarifications to the prompt, stating that the reported outcome should include all components and details of the primary outcome. Each version was re-evaluated on the validation set until it reduced this error type while preserving F 1 F_{1} score and accuracy.
blocks.zh: 然后我们把Youden指数应用到100进取训练集中,以确定分类阈值,并用它来得到200进取验证集的二进制预测. 我们手动检查了OLMo模型中错误分类的情况并找出了三种重复出现的错误类型:(a) 域名和缩略语知识不足(例如,HbA1c),(b) 对较长句子理解不足,(c) 接受部分报告的结果。 我们讨论了(c) ,反复澄清,指出所报告的结果应包括主要结果的所有组成部分和细节。 每个版本在验证集上被重新评价,直到它缩小了这个错误类型,同时保留了F 1 FQQQ1}的分数和准确性.

blocks.zh: 域名和缩略语知识不足(例如,HbA1c.),

blocks.en: poor comprehension of longer sentences, and

blocks.en: 3.5. Ensemble models
blocks.zh: 3.5. 组合模型

blocks.en: In the final evaluation, we included ensemble models, more specifically hard voting classifiers with a majority threshold. Each ensemble was composed of the three models with the highest F 1 F_{1} score on the validation set from their respective group. This improved the F 1 F_{1} score over any single model in the group. The ensembles were:
blocks.zh: 在最后评价中,我们包括了综艺模型,更具体地说,有多数门槛的硬投票分类器. 每个综艺节目均由各自团体在审定组合上得分最高的F 1 FQQQ1}的三种模式组成. 这改善了F 1 FQQQ1}的得分,超过了小组中任何一个单一模式. 综艺节目是:

blocks.en: 4. Results
blocks.zh: 4.四. 结果

blocks.en: 4.1. Outcome Classification
blocks.zh: 4.1. 结果分类

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the results of all evaluated models on the 2,496 instance test set. The sentence transformer achieved the best baseline F 1 F_{1} score of 0.67 with a classification accuracy of 0.82. Among LLMs with the original prompt, BioMistral achieved the best F 1 F_{1} of 0.73 and accuracy of 0.88. With the corrected prompt, OLMo’ achieved the best F 1 F_{1} of 0.75 and accuracy of 0.89. The best overall result was achieved by LLM’ voting with an F 1 F_{1} of 0.78 and accuracy of 0.90 , an improvement of 7 percentage points over baseline voting. Koroleva et al. (2019) reported F 1 F_{1} values between 0.87 and 0.90 with fine-tuned BERT models on a non-deduplicated dataset of outcome pairs.
blocks.zh: 表2显示在2 496个实例测试中所有评价模型的结果。 句子变压器达到最佳基准F 1 F_{1}分数0.67分,分类精度为0.82分. 在LLMs中,具有原始快感的BioMistral取得了0.73和0.88的最佳F 1 FQQQ 1}的精度. 校正后,OLMo获得了0.75的最好F 1 F_{1}和0.89的准确性。 LLM的表决取得了最佳的总体结果,F 1 F QQQ 1}为0.78,准确度为0.90,比基线投票提高了7个百分点。 Koroleva等人(2019年)报告F 1 F% 1 值在0.87至0.90之间,在结果对的不重复数据集上对BERT模型进行了微调.

blocks.en: 4.2. Explanation

Deep learning baseline models and the proposed LLM approach are essentially black boxes , producing only a similarity score with no explanation of their decisions. For authors and reviewers of clinical trial reports, understanding why two outcomes were classified as similar or different is important. Since LLMs can interpret the problem and generate text, they are suitable for producing natural language explanations . We obtained explanations for already classified examples by inserting the model prediction and continuing the conversation with the user message “Why? Explain your answer.” Zhang et al., 2024 Two examples generated by OLMo are shown below:
blocks.zh: 深层学习基线模型和拟议的LLM方法基本上是黑盒,只产生相似性分数,而没有解释其决定。 对于临床试验报告的作者和审查者来说,了解为什么将两种结果归类为类似或不同是重要的。 由于LLMS可以解释问题并生成文本,因此它们适合生成自然语言解释. 我们通过插入模型预测并继续与用户信息“为什么?” 继续对话,获得了对已经分类的例子的解释。 解释你的回答。” 张等,2024年. 法律厅产生的两个例子如下:

blocks.en: 5. Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 讨论情况

blocks.en: LLMs outperformed all baseline text similarity models in F 1 F_{1} , which we attribute to defining the task context and the asymmetric relationship between the primary and reported outcome. Since we used LLMs as adaptive classifiers via prompting, they remained general-purpose. BioMistral performed better with minimal prompts while Mistral benefited from more context, indicating that domain adaptation influences prompt sensitivity. Llama followed the corrected instructions too strictly Zhou et al., 2023 , as its recall dropped to 0.33 and F 1 F_{1} to 0.49, making it an unusable classifier. Individual classification thresholds, obtained by maximizing the Youden index, compensated for model biases. Majority voting across LLMs further improved results, indicating that the models made distinct mistakes and complemented each other.
blocks.zh: LLMS在F 1 F_{1}中的表现超过了所有基线文本相似性模型,我们将此归结为定义任务背景和主结果与所报告结果之间的不对称关系. 由于我们通过提示方式将LLMs用作适应性分类,它们仍然是通用的. BioMistral在最小提示下表现较好,而Mistral则从更多的上下文中受益,表明域适应影响即时敏感度. Llama太严格地遵循了2023年周等人的改正指示,因为其召回率下降到了0.33和F 1 FQQQ 1}下降到了0.49,使它成为一个无法使用的分类器. 个人分类阈值,通过最大化Youden指数获得,补偿模型偏差. 多数人对法学硕士和硕士学位进行投票,这进一步改善了成果,表明这些模式犯了不同的错误并相互补充。

blocks.en: Our results still trail behind fine-tuned BERT models by about 10 percentage points on F 1 F_{1} score. Part of the reason is that we worked with only 10% of the dataset for development and deduplicated instances, making the task harder. Thresholds tuned on this small, randomly sampled dataset can be unstable and vary across models. We also used LLMs to generate natural language explanations for the classified examples. A manual qualitative analysis showed that more than 50% of explanations are valuable , while approximately every tenth contains hallucinations.
blocks.zh: 我们的成绩仍然落后于精细调整的BERT模型, 部分原因是我们只用10%的数据集来开发 和复制实例,使任务更难完成。 以这个小的,随机抽样的数据集为调取的阈值可能不稳定并因模型而异. 我们还利用LLMs为分类实例生成自然语言解释. 手动的定性分析显示,50%以上的解释是有价值的,而大约每十分之一的解释含有幻觉。

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: We investigated whether smaller open-source LLMs can classify pairs of outcomes based on text similarity as part of detecting outcome switching in RCT reports. For this purpose, we used a dataset of primary and reported outcomes labeled for similarity. Through prompt engineering, OLMo achieved the best F 1 F_{1} score of 0.75, and majority voting of three LLMs improved it to 0.78. Other contributions include automatic threshold tuning, classification based on next token probabilities, and the option to explain the model decision. Our approach requires only a few hundred instances and no parameter fine-tuning. All source code and results, including model predictions and explanations, are publicly available in a GitHub repository. 9 9 9 https://github.com/ta5946/Spin
blocks.zh: 我们调查了较小的开源有限责任公司是否可以根据文本相似性对成对结果进行分类,作为检测RCT报告中结果切换的一部分. 为此目的,我们使用一套主要成果和报告的类似结果。 通过即时工程,OLMo获得了最佳F 1 FQQQ1}0.75分的得分,3个LLM的多数票将其提升至0.78分. 其他贡献包括自动阈值调整,根据下个符号概率进行分类,以及解释模型决定的选项. 我们的方法只需要几百例,没有参数微调。 所有源代码和结果,包括模型预测和解释,均可在GitHub仓库中公开查阅。

blocks.en: As future work, we propose evaluating larger, more capable LLMs . A complete spin detection pipeline would have to be extended to other types of spin and related tasks, such as outcome extraction and discrepancy judgment. Alternatively, models with longer context windows could analyze whole reports at once, replacing intermediate steps with reasoning. To ensure cross-lingual reliability, the experiments should be repeated with a machine-translated or separately collected dataset.
blocks.zh: 作为今后的工作,我们提议评价更大、更有能力的法学硕士课程。 整个自旋探测管道必须扩大到其他类型的自旋和相关任务,如结果提取和差异判断等。 或者,具有较长上下文窗口的模型可以同时分析整个报告,以推理取而代之。 为确保跨语种的可靠性,试验应当用一台机器翻译或单独收集的数据集重复进行。
